segments.an3.112:1.3: Atīte, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati;
segments.an3.112:1.4: anāgate, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati;
segments.an3.112:1.5: paccuppanne, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:1.6: Kathañca, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati?
segments.an3.112:1.7: Atīte, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
segments.an3.112:1.8: Tassa atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:1.10: Etamahaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃyojanaṃ vadāmi yo cetaso sārāgo.
segments.an3.112:1.11: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati?
segments.an3.112:2.2: Anāgate, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
segments.an3.112:2.3: Tassa anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:2.5: Etamahaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃyojanaṃ vadāmi yo cetaso sārāgo.
segments.an3.112:2.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati?
segments.an3.112:3.2: Paccuppanne, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
segments.an3.112:3.3: Tassa paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:3.5: Etamahaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃyojanaṃ vadāmi yo cetaso sārāgo.
segments.an3.112:3.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
segments.an3.112:3.7: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya.
segments.an3.112:4.3: Atīte, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati;
segments.an3.112:4.4: anāgate bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati;
segments.an3.112:4.5: paccuppanne, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
segments.an3.112:5.1: Kathañca, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati?
segments.an3.112:5.2: Atītānaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti.
segments.an3.112:5.4: Tadabhinivattetvā [tadabhinivajjeti, tadabhinivajjetvā (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] cetasā abhinivijjhitvā [abhivirājetvā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] paññāya ativijjha [abhinivijjha (ka.)] passati.
segments.an3.112:5.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
segments.an3.112:6.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati?
segments.an3.112:6.2: Anāgatānaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti.
segments.an3.112:6.4: Tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhinivijjhitvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
segments.an3.112:6.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
segments.an3.112:7.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati?
segments.an3.112:7.2: Paccuppannānaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti, āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti, tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhinivijjhitvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
segments.an3.112:7.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
segments.an3.112:7.4: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāyā”ti.

lines: Yo cetaso sārāgoti yo cittassa rāgo rajjanā rajjitattaṃ, etamahaṃ saṃyojanaṃ vadāmi, bandhanaṃ vadāmīti attho.
Yadā vā tena vipāko ñāto hoti vidito, tadā te ceva dhamme tañca vipākaṃ abhinivatteti.
Iminā ca padena vipassanā kathitā, tadabhinivattetvāti iminā maggo.
Paññāya ativijjha passatīti saha vipassanāya maggapaññāya nibbijjhitvā passati.
Tadabhinivattetīti ettha taṃ -saddena paccāmasanassa vipākassa parāmāsoti āha “taṃ abhinivattetī”ti, taṃ vipākaṃ abhibhavitvā nivattetīti attho.
Idāni na kevalaṃ vipākasseva parāmāso taṃ-saddena, atha kho chandarāgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ tabbipākassa ca parāmāso daṭṭhabboti āha “yadā vā tenā”tiādi.
Nibbijjhitvā passatīti kilese nibbijjhitvā vibhūtaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā passatīti.
